app.title: Listful Thinking
app.tagline: Wishlists, chores, and event lists for self-hosters.
app.intro: Your wishes, plans, and everyday lists, together.

auth.emailSent: If that email exists and identifies the account, a link has been sent. For a shared email address, enter your username too.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You can log in now.
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Log in with the new password.
auth.registrationDisabled: Self-registration is currently disabled. Ask an administrator to create your account.
auth.bootstrapHelp: Enter the setup code from your server's bootstrap secret. It is needed only for the first account.
auth.bootstrapUnavailable: First-admin setup is not configured. Create a bootstrap secret on the server, then reload this page.
auth.recoveryHelp: Enter your account email. No password is needed. For a shared email address, also enter your username.
auth.validEmailRequired: Enter a valid account email address.

capture.help: Paste a page link, review what was found, then choose where to save it.
capture.sourceHint: Suggested from {site}. Check and edit before saving.
capture.title: Title
capture.variant: Exact size, colour, model, or buyer note
capture.releaseConfirm: Release this reservation so someone else can claim it?
capture.onePerLine: One item per line; edit or remove anything you do not need.
capture.confirmHelp: These are suggestions from the page. Check names, variants, price, and date before saving.
capture.partial: Saved {count} item(s). The remaining lines are still here; review them before retrying.
capture.manualFallback: The page could not be read. You can still enter and save details manually.
capture.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS page URL.
capture.previewFailed: Could not read this page. Please try again.
capture.duplicate: A similar product is already in this list: {names}
capture.listRequired: Choose a list or name a new one.
capture.eventRequired: An event needs a title and date.
capture.linesRequired: Keep at least one item to add.
capture.saveFailed: Could not save this draft. Please try again.

errors.request_failed: The request failed. Please try again.
errors.network_error: The server could not be reached. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.conflict: That change conflicts with the current list state. Refresh and try again.
errors.registration_disabled: Self-registration is currently disabled. Ask an administrator to create your account.
errors.bootstrap_token_invalid: The first-admin setup code is invalid. Check the server's bootstrap secret.
errors.malformed_json: The request could not be read. Please try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.csrf_required: Your session needs to be refreshed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_found: That item could not be found.
errors.stale_item: This item changed in another session. Reload the list and review the latest version before saving.
errors.list_type_in_use: Empty the list before changing its type.
errors.email_unavailable: Email recovery is unavailable. Ask the administrator to configure outgoing email.
errors.email_delivery_failed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later or contact the administrator.
errors.list_inactive: Restore the archived list before making changes. Templates cannot be shared.

lists.title: Your lists
lists.deleteRetention: This list can be restored from Trash for two weeks. Its public link stops working now.

items.imageTooLarge: Images must be 3.5 MB or smaller.
items.deleteWarning: Move this item to Trash? You can restore it for two weeks.
items.clearWarning: Move all completed grocery items to Trash? You can restore them for two weeks.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.replaceWarning: Replace this public link? Previously shared links will stop working.
sharing.activeLinkHint: A public link is active for eight weeks. Copy a new link now: it is shown only once. Replacing it invalidates the previous link.
sharing.accessGranted: Access granted to {username}. They will see this list and a notification when they next open the app.
sharing.transferHelp: The new owner gets full control. You lose access unless they share the list back. Its public link stops working; other account shares remain.
sharing.transferConfirm: Transfer {title} to {username}? You will lose access and its public link will stop working.
sharing.transferred: Ownership transferred. The new owner has been notified.

admin.title: Admin
admin.roleHelpUser: Members can use lists shared with them. They cannot manage accounts or instance settings.
admin.roleHelpAdmin: Administrators can manage accounts and instance settings. Choose this only for someone who needs that access.
admin.lastActiveAdminHint: At least one active admin must remain.
admin.setupHelp: Leave the password blank to create a one-time setup link. Share it privately if email is unavailable. Providing a password uses the existing manual account flow.
admin.setupNotEmailed: No setup email was sent. Give this link to the user through a private channel.
admin.linkCreated: A new one-time link was issued. Earlier setup and recovery links no longer work.
admin.transferConfirm: Transfer all {count} lists owned by inactive {source} to {target}? This includes archived lists, templates, and Trash. Public links will be revoked.
admin.transferred: {count} lists transferred. The new owner has been notified.
admin.transferredOne: 1 list transferred. The new owner has been notified.
admin.listPrivacy: Administration shows usage counts. List contents are visible only to their owner and people they share with.

ux.adminHelp: Manage accounts and instance settings here. Your everyday lists live in the main workspace.
ux.listsHelp: A little less to remember. A place for every list.
ux.readOnlyHelp: Shared with you: you can view this list. Ask the owner if you need to make changes.
ux.contributorHelp: Shared with you: you can add and update items. The owner manages sharing and list settings.
ux.settingsHelp: Change this list’s details, make a copy, or delete it.
ux.typeLocked: The list type is fixed while it contains items. Create a new list for a different purpose.
ux.sharingHelp: Anyone with a public link can read this list, including notes, images and guest names, without an account. The link expires after eight weeks or when you revoke it. For personal information, invite specific people instead.
ux.invitePeople: Share with someone who has an account
ux.inviteHelp: Access starts immediately. Read-only lets people view items; contributors can add and update them. They will receive an in-app notification.
ux.emptyItemsHelp: Add your first item above. You can keep it simple and add details later.
ux.emptyReadOnly: Nothing here yet. The owner can add items to this list.
ux.noResultsHelp: Try another search or reset your filters.
ux.firstListHelp: A wishlist, the weekly shop, or those little jobs you don’t want to forget. Pick a purpose and give it a name.
ux.listCreated: List created. Add your first item below.
ux.publicViewHelp: Browse this list. This link gives you viewing access.
ux.publicClaimHelp: Choose an available item and enter your name to reserve it. Others will see that it’s taken.

purpose.WISH: Keep things you’d love. Add a name, or paste a product link to review it before saving.
purpose.TODO: Get it out of your head. Add a task, then mark it done when you’re finished.
purpose.GROCERY: Plan your next shop. Add items and quantities; use categories to group your aisles.
purpose.CHORE: Share the everyday jobs. Add due dates and repeating schedules in More details.
purpose.EVENT: Bring a plan together. Set the event date, then add tasks and people responsible.

ux.resetHelp: Choose a password with at least 8 characters. You can then return to sign in.

planning.clearDayHelp: No dated work is due in this period. Your undated items are still in Your lists.
planning.freshCopy: A fresh private list: items start open, reservations and completion history are cleared, and old item dates are not copied. Set new dates after creating it.
planning.archivedPreview: Archived: this list is paused and read-only. Restore it from List settings to continue. Its old public link has been revoked.
planning.templatePreview: Template blueprint: edit its reusable items here. Templates stay private and do not send reminders. Use Templates to create a fresh working list.
planning.restored: Restored. Deleted or archived public links stay revoked.
planning.templateSaved: Template saved. Use it whenever you need a fresh list.
planning.createdFromTemplate: Your fresh list is ready. Set any dates you need before using reminders.
planning.deleteTemplateConfirm: Move this template to Trash? Existing lists created from it are kept.
planning.loadFailed: This view could not be loaded. Use Refresh to try again.

help.today: A view of dated work across your own and shared lists. Today is your local calendar day; upcoming covers the following seven days.
help.archive: Keep finished or paused lists without cluttering your active workspace. Archived lists send no reminders and are hidden from collaborators until restored.
help.templates: Reusable starting points for trips, shopping and events. Each use creates an independent private list.
help.trash: Deleted lists and items can be restored for two weeks, then are permanently removed. Public links are not re-enabled by restoring.

empty.templates: Start with a list you already love.

emptyHelp.archive: Use Archive list in a list’s settings when you want to pause it.
emptyHelp.templates: Open a list’s settings and choose Save as template. Reuse it here for a fresh start.
emptyHelp.trash: Deleted lists, templates and items can be recovered here for two weeks, even after refreshing or signing in again.

privacy.imageHint: Loading this image contacts {host} and shares your IP address.
